name: finch-chan
description: Send privacy-safe Finch activity states to a paired StackChan pet on your local network.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run doctor

finch.name: FinchChan
finch.description: Send privacy-safe Finch activity states to a paired StackChan pet on your local network.
finch.systemPrompt: Use finchchan_control only when the user asks to pair, inspect, speak through, set the visible state of, or unpair their FinchChan StackChan pet. action=status reports the bridge and paired devices; pair creates a short-lived pairing code for a specific device id; say sends a short visible message; state sets one finite pet state; unpair revokes a device token. Never use this tool to transmit prompts, conversation text, or tool parameters.
